text:
Aisha Khan: Heads up — Beacon Bank sent back the SIG with a few follow-ups. They want per-question evidence for Q33 (data residency controls), Q46 (third-party subprocessors list + contracts), and Q19 (KMS rotation + BYOK). Can we gather artifacts and short one-line answers for each row? Need to get back before COB tomorrow PT.

Diego Marquez: I can take Q33 and Q46. For residency we usually provide our dataflow diagram + region mappings and the storage class ACL screenshot. I have an SVG of the architecture we can export.

Priya Rao: I’ll handle Q19 (KMS). We support multiple deployment models; need to be explicit about Hosted vs Private. For Hosted: we offer customer-managed keys via Cloud KMS integration in select regions; for Private: we can integrate with customer HSM.

Aisha Khan: Perfect. Reviewer specifically asked for: 1) evidence_url for each row; 2) a short policy sentence for each; 3) proof of a rotation event in last 90 days for the key type.

Diego Marquez: For subprocessors (Q46) — we keep a canonical CSV in the legal registry. I’ll pull the latest export, redact vendor contact emails, and attach. Command I use locally:

```
# export subprocessors list (redact emails)
cat subprocessors-registry.csv | csvcut -c vendor,service,region,contract_signed | csvgrep -c contract_signed -m true > subprocessors-signed.csv
```

I’ll scrub emails and upload.

Priya Rao: Running a log query to find rotation events for our KMS integrations. Example (AWS CloudTrail):

```
# filter rotation events for KMS CMKs
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=EnableKeyRotation --start-time "2025-12-01T00:00:00Z" --end-time "2026-03-01T00:00:00Z" --output json
```

I’ll pull a CSV summary with timestamps and key aliases (redacted).

Aisha Khan: Diego, can you also produce the dataflow PNG with region labels? The reviewer likes a one-page diagram.

Diego Marquez: Yep. Exporting public diagram and attaching the source link. Also will include the storage class screenshot showing region tag.

Priya Rao: Draft language for Q19 for their SIG cell: "Redwood supports customer-managed keys (BYOK) for Hosted customers in supported regions via Cloud KMS providers (AWS KMS, Google Cloud KMS, Azure Key Vault). For Private deployments Redwood integrates with customer HSMs. Key rotation is configurable and rotation events are recorded in audit logs and available for export." Thoughts?

Aisha Khan: Good. Add one sentence about key escrow: "Redwood does not escrow customer keys in Hosted by default; customer keys remain under customer control unless explicitly provisioned via Redwood-managed services as part of a contract."

Priya Rao: Added. Final draft: "Redwood supports customer-managed keys (BYOK) for Hosted customers in supported regions via Cloud KMS providers (AWS KMS, Google Cloud KMS, Azure Key Vault). For Private deployments Redwood integrates with customer HSMs. Keys are not escrowed by Redwood by default; customers retain control unless otherwise contracted. Key rotation is configurable and rotation events are recorded in audit logs and available for export."

Diego Marquez: Uploading artifacts now. Will include: dataflow-diagram.png, region-mapping.png, subprocessors-signed.csv (redacted), subprocessors-contracts.pdf (redacted clause pages).

artifact-bot: Uploaded to https://drive.redwood.internal/sig/beacon-1920/ — contains: dataflow-diagram.png, region-mapping.png, subprocessors-signed.csv, subprocessors-contracts-redacted.pdf, kms-rotation-summary.csv, kms-rotation-screenshot.png

Aisha Khan: Great. contract-bot, can you confirm we have signed DPA or subprocessor clauses for the vendors listed?

contract-bot: Checked registry for vendors in subprocessors-signed.csv — all vendors show a signed DPA with standard subprocessor clause. Redactions removed; full contract references at https://contracts.redwood.internal/registry/ (internal access required). :white_check_mark:

Priya Rao: Confirmed the rotation summary shows automated rotation on 2026-02-14 for alias redwood-acme-demo-key (alias redacted in CSV). Screenshot of rotation schedule also in the folder.

Diego Marquez: I also added a short one-line for Q33: "Redwood supports region-restricted storage by configuring regional storage classes and routing policy; customer tenancy can be pinned to specific cloud regions as part of onboarding."

Aisha Khan: I'll update the SIG spreadsheet rows with the drive link and the short statements. If reviewer requests signed SLA language or a customer-specific subprocessors addendum, I'll loop Legal. Thanks all — will notify when they've accepted. :pray: :sparkles:
